nodes.name: Webhook - Get Attribute Terms
nodes.notes:
GET endpoint to retrieve all terms for a specific product attribute.
Requires query parameter: attribute_id (integer)
Example: ?attribute_id=1 returns all terms for attribute ID 1 (e.g., Red, Blue for Color)

nodes.name: HTTP Request - Get Attribute Terms
nodes.notes:
Fetches all terms for a specific product attribute.
Endpoint: GET /wp-json/wc/v3/products/attributes/{id}/terms
Returns terms like Red, Blue, Green for Color attribute.
